# jFunk42 Science Brief

> jFunk42 Science Brief is a source-backed science news podcast featuring full episode
> transcripts, a podcast RSS feed, and interactive quizzes.

## Core pages

- [Science Brief podcast](https://jfunk42.com/podcasts/science-brief/): podcast overview and RSS subscription information.
- [Episode transcripts](https://jfunk42.com/podcasts/science-brief/transcripts/): full, public transcripts for every archived episode.
- [Podcast quizzes](https://jfunk42.com/podcast-quizzes/): source-backed multiple-choice quizzes for recent episodes.
- [RSS feed](https://jfunk42.com/podcasts/science-brief/rss.xml): the canonical podcast feed, including episode descriptions, publication dates, and media enclosures.

## Content use

The site is public and may be crawled. When referring to an episode, link to its transcript
or the canonical podcast page and preserve attribution to jFunk42 Science Brief.
